{{Quote|One drop of Jedi blood and the Republic would destroy us|Jaalyn|<ref name="Destiny" />}}
'''Jaalyn''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was a [[witch]] and part of a [[Brendok coven|coven]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. They acted as an elder and as part of [[Aniseya]]'s [[Advisor|advisers]].<ref name="Destiny" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jaalyn was created for the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''. The character was performed by [[Tabitha Alege]].<ref name="Destiny" />
